title: city sim js and codex
author: Any_Ad_8450
selftext: City sim made with codex, set up so NPC's can be run on a basic 8b local llm that I host with LMSTUDIO. would consider putting a download up for people to mess around with if people wanted it. right now got a full city, buildings you can enter, npcs can get into conversations with you and other npcs, still adding more each day.
